Lina (AE): Hi all — Vendor legal just approved the SOW but customer Ops asked for clarification on offline upgrade cadence and rollback strategy for the air-gapped POC. Can we outline what we can commit to?
Raj (SE): We can provide signed bundles + delta patching. For POC we usually do a one-time full bundle, then up to monthly delta patches.
Lina (AE): Customer wants an option for more frequent security patches — every 2 weeks ideally. Is that feasible?
Raj (SE): 2-week cadence is possible but depends on customer-side deployment process. We can deliver small security deltas as signed chunks. They must have a jumpbox or an approved channel to ingest patches.
Ben (Eng): Technical constraints: deltas are binary diffs against the installed image. They reduce size but require deterministic packaging. We currently support: full tarball (.tar.gz) and chunked signed deltas. Verification via sha256 + signature.
Marta (Customer Success): Ops team will require an offline signed manifest and SBOM for each bundle. They also want clear rollback steps if a patch fails.
Raj (SE): We'll supply: 1) signed manifest.json with artifact list + checksums, 2) SBOM (CycloneDX), 3) PGP/RSA signature for bundle, 4) checksum verification script. Rollback: keep previous bundle cached on node, verify signatures before applying, and run rollback script to restore previous image.
Ben (Eng): Sample verification command we recommend:
```bash
curl -O https://artifacts.example.com/bundle.tar.gz.sig
sha256sum -c manifest.sha256
gpg --verify bundle.tar.gz.sig bundle.tar.gz
```
(For air-gapped they run this on the jumpbox after transferring files.)
Lia (Legal): Quick flag — customer asked about export controls and cryptographic strength for signing. We need to confirm key lengths and whether we can vendor-provide signatures or if they must use their HSM.
Raj (SE): We support both modes. For high-security customers we provide unsigned artifacts and a signing guide so they can sign locally with HSM/KMS. For our signed bundles we use RSA-4096 and SHA-256. We'll document process in the POC runbook.
Lina (AE): Pricing question: do we charge extra for frequent delta builds and signed SBOMs during POC? Customer asked if we can include it in the pilot.
Marta (Customer Success): We typically include one month of delta support in pilot credits. Anything beyond that (e.g., 2-week cadence for 3+ months) is billable as "accelerated patching". We should confirm with sales ops.
Lina (AE): Noted — I'll flag with Sales Ops. Another Ops ask: how do we handle cert rotation offline (CA certs / client certs)?
Raj (SE): Provide a cert-rotation tool in the bundle. Process: 1) create new certs on jumpbox, 2) sign them with customer CA or upload to HSM, 3) distribute signed certs with manifest and apply with a graceful restart. We'll include a runbook snippet.
Ben (Eng): Also: rollback safety nets — health-check endpoint and automatic revert if > N failed requests in M minutes. We set defaults in POC but allow tuning.
Marta (Customer Success): Ops wants signed attestations for each build (who built it + artifact hash). Can we add builder metadata?
Raj (SE): Yes, we'll include build metadata (CI run id, builder id, git commit) in the manifest. For air-gapped customers we can embed a reproducible build tag.
Lia (Legal): OK — I'll follow up on export control language for the SOW.
Lina (AE): Great. Action items: Raj to draft POC runbook + manifest template, Ben to add signature/checksum verification snippet, Marta to confirm delta-support scope with customer, Lia to update SOW language, Lina to confirm pricing with Sales Ops. ETA: EOD Thursday?
Raj (SE): I'll have the runbook draft by Thursday afternoon.
Ben (Eng): I'll push a verification example to the repo and ping deploy-bot.
deploy-bot: artifact build 2024-05-21 14:12:12 -> bundle-20240521.tar.gz (sha256: e3b0c442...) :white_check_mark:
Marta (Customer Success): :thumbsup: thanks team, I'll prep the customer checklist and gate review.
Lina (AE): Thanks — I'll update the customer and wait for Sales Ops on pricing.
